patch_primary.context: SLEEVE_WEIGHTS dict — primary runtime dict used by compute_position_size()
patch_primary.impact: CRITICAL: all production position sizing flows through this value

patch_json_state.context: sleeve_weights dict — persisted state read by load_state(), backfilled into runtime
patch_json_state.impact: REQUIRED: without this, load_state() may backfill 0.75 over leverage_manager
patch_json_state.note: Update BOTH files atomically. JSON state is read by k280_daily_run.py via AUM tracking.

patch_aum_manager.context: DEFAULT_SLEEVE_WEIGHTS — used ONLY when portfolio_aum_state.json does not exist
patch_aum_manager.impact: LOW (only affects fresh installs / state reset), but update for consistency
patch_aum_manager.note: Also update the docstring on line 17: '75%' → '60%'

patch_aum_manager_docstring.after: K280:        60%  →  position = deployed_capital × 0.60  # K552 Phase B1
patch_aum_manager_docstring.context: Module-level docstring — documentation only, no runtime impact

do_not_change.reason: This is used for DISPLAY-ONLY combined dashboard math (K302a satellite view). Changing it would break the satellite dashboard's weighting display. It does NOT drive position sizing.

step1_verify_before.expected: 3 lines showing 0.75 (leverage_manager L74, aum_state L18, portfolio_aum_manager L86)

step2_apply_patch.cmd_primary: sed -i '' 's/"K280":   0\.75,   # K280 main (K198 + K208 + K276b) — v6\.13d; v6\.16 reduces to 0\.72/"K280":   0.60,   # K280 main (K539 Phase B1: 75→60%, frees 7.5pp HL, 2026-05-30)/' scripts/leverage_manager.py

step5_hl_recompute.formula: K280 HL component = 0.60 × AUM × deployment_pct × K208_HL_fraction
step5_hl_recompute.K208_HL_pct_of_K280: ~50% of K280 notional on HL (split HL+Bybit)
step5_hl_recompute.calc_at_10M: 0.60 × $9.2M deployed × 0.50 HL = $2.76M on HL → ~30% HL direct
step5_hl_recompute.note: v6.13d HL was 57.5% includes paired trades; after K280 cut, K449 5% HL adds back ~2.5pp → net ~50% HL
step5_hl_recompute.k449_K376_headroom: 7.5pp freed directly from K280 cut; comfortable for K449(5%) + K376 family

step7_sum_check.description: Verify sleeve weights still sum correctly post-patch
step7_sum_check.cmd: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/portfolio_aum_state.json')); w=d['sleeve_weights']; print('Sum:', sum(w.values()), '\nWeights:', w)"
step7_sum_check.expected_note: Sum will be 0.60+0.20+0.05+0.03=0.88 (K376 is sub-slice of K280, total < 1.0 is valid per design)

rollback.description: Revert K280 from 0.60 back to 0.75 if patch causes issues
rollback.rollback_primary: sed -i '' 's/"K280":   0\.60,   # K280 main (K539 Phase B1: 75→60%, frees 7.5pp HL, 2026-05-30)/"K280":   0.75,   # K280 main (K198 + K208 + K276b) — v6.13d; v6.16 reduces to 0.72/' scripts/leverage_manager.py
rollback.rollback_json: python3 -c "import json; f='data/portfolio_aum_state.json'; d=json.load(open(f)); d['sleeve_weights']['K280']=0.75; json.dump(d, open(f,'w'), indent=2)"
rollback.then_restart: launchctl unload/load for k280-live and k302a-satellite
trigger_rollback_if: HL exposure rises unexpectedly > 65% after K449 add
rollback.git_backup: git stash (before applying) or git diff HEAD for comparison
